name: Nature Networks Fund
summary: Capital-focused grants of £250,000 to £1 million for habitat work on and around Wales' protected sites, run by the National Lottery Heritage Fund for the Welsh Government with Natural Resources Wales. Round six is closed to new expressions of interest.
reporting: Grantees submit an evaluation report before the last 10% of the grant is paid, and share monitoring data and geo-spatial data on where the project worked.
